bug_fixed.issue: 500 Internal Server Error on POST /api/marketing/v2/contacts/{contact_id}/fetch-metrics when recording YouTube history
bug_fixed.root_cause: Line 923 in marketing_v2.py used results.get('youtube', {}).get('success') but when youtube key exists with None value, the .get('youtube', {}) returns None instead of {}, causing AttributeError on .get('success')
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to null-safe pattern: yt_data = results.get('youtube') if results else None; if yt_data and isinstance(yt_data, dict) and yt_data.get('success')
